work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent act with Clement XII protocol at 69814-69815. Adrian VI and Sixtus V appear only as predecessors in the historical recital; no independent predecessor protocol is present. Complete numbered opening, disposition, final clauses, dating 70082-70084, and repeated date 70086 are retained. All eight historical notes belong to this act and are retained: 69895, 69897; 69949, 69951, 69953; 70006, 70008, 70010, with local lexical markers/subjects. Previous act ends 69804 and next starts 70089. No displaced or shared-line apparatus or act-boundary blocker found in the reviewed OCR. The later notes 70118, 70120, and 70242 have local referents at 70104, 70108, and 70209 in the next act, not in this act. Source-extent re-audit: prior letters are summarized and cited at 69830-69872 as antecedents, not claimed complete predecessor acts. The present abolition, assignment of government, conditions, and final clauses at 69978-70080 are printed. No literal formula abbreviation or cross-reference replaces this current act's substantive body. Admission is of the complete bounded printed witness without expansion.
